name: proc-to-pay
description: Full-stack JavaScript application with Node.js backend and React frontend

scripts.dev: npm run validate-env && concurrently "npm run server:dev" "npm run client"
scripts.dev:debug: npm run validate-env && concurrently "npm run server:debug" "npm run client"
scripts.server:debug-verbose: npm run validate-env && DEBUG=* nodemon --inspect server.js
scripts.start:prod: NODE_ENV=production npm run setup && npm run validate-env && node server.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.debug:prisma: npm run validate-env && DEBUG=prisma:* nodemon server.js
scripts.debug:express: npm run validate-env && DEBUG=express:* nodemon server.js
scripts.debug:all: npm run validate-env && DEBUG=* nodemon --inspect server.js
